 ENGR 190WSSI, & SSII - STAFFJeffrey M ForestaJeffrey M ForestaJeffrey M ForestaMultiple offerings in SSI, SSII, Fall, Winter, and Spring. All Engineering majors' and CSE majors' Graduation Application must be in 'received' status to have first consideration for enrollment. (To clarify: All graduation applications received for Fall will have first consideration for registration in the Fall quarter. All graduation applications received for Winter will have first consideration for registration in the Winter quarter. All graduation applications received for Spring will have first consideration for registration in the Spring quarter.).
